fixesOpened.reporter: ❤️ 201k [OILY] in Discord #general-chat (Oct 28, 8:25 AM PT), and charan agreed (8:43 AM PT)
fixesOpened.whatWasWrong: Starting a session stops whatever the person was listening to on Spotify or Apple Music. The app is meant to let their music keep playing.
fixesOpened.whatChanged: iOS lets the camera grab the phone's sound by default, even though Latent never records sound, and that paused Spotify and Apple Music when the camera started. The fix tells the camera not to touch the phone's sound (plus a test). Camera-off, the timer alarm and full-screen video were already fine and aren't touched.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: On a real phone (the simulator can't test this): play Spotify, open Latent, tap Record with the camera on. The song should keep going through pause, resume and Finish. Also try camera off. The timer alarm may briefly lower the song, full-screen videos still take over the sound, and feed songs still autoplay, all as before.
